title: A股跌幅收窄、港股科技走强，工业富联绩后逆势确认AI算力主线
summary: 截至10:18 CST，上证跌0.63%、创业板跌1.33%，恒指涨1.17%、恒科涨1.22%。工业富联第三季净利润同比增60.35%，股价逆势涨1.17%，新增为确认关注；中际旭创、生益科技、东方证券仍未重回再评估阈值，百威亚太反弹也未改变负面基本面。

关键词云图

美股通信服务AI资本开支A股跌幅收窄港股科技走强通信网络政策光模块接近闸门覆铜板价格失效券商并购未确认啤酒需求海南自贸港油价高位工业富联确认
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东外交预期压低油价，但供应风险未解除
Brent结算114.88美元、跌0.38%，WTI结算102美元、跌0.76%；美伊接触预期与胡塞袭击、霍尔木兹风险并存。来源：Reuters。
政策
四部门发布海南自贸港贸易便利化措施
10月29日通知覆盖汽车测试进口、LNG期货交割、保险、离岸贸易和再制造等16项措施；受益需等实施与订单。来源：商务部。
产业
工信部部署新一代通信网络协同建设
会议提出基础、空间、国际和融合网络协同发展，并研究土地、电力、频率和金融支持；这是中期线索，不等于当日订单。来源：工信部。
市场
A股成长继续下挫，港股科技逆势企稳
截至10月30日09:45 CST，上证跌1.21%、创业板跌3.16%，恒指涨0.62%、恒科涨0.30%；A/H由同步科技承压转为A弱H稳。来源：东方财富云端行情。
美股
通信服务与软件重挫，互联网内容行业垫底
纳指跌1.37%、费半跌1.4%；Alphabet跌12.6%，FTNT与NOW均跌逾20%，MRVL跌13.2%。互联网内容与信息-9.77%，汽车经销+7.57%、安全防护+5.95%。来源：Reuters、排行快照。
盘后
Amazon与Intel强化AI投入回报压力
AWS收入增39%至460亿美元，但Amazon 12个月自由现金流为-424亿美元、资本开支高于预期，盘后最多跌7%；Intel的PC指引负反馈更重。来源：Reuters。
业绩
工业富联业绩与价格共同确认AI算力分支
第三季营收3835.54亿元、同比增57.73%，归母净利润166.34亿元、同比增60.35%；云计算收入同比增75%、环比增25%，AI-GPU机柜出货量同比增70%。截至10:18股价45.75元、涨1.17%，相对上证形成正向确认。来源：法定披露全文、东方财富云端行情。
业绩
中际旭创业绩高增，公告前弱势构成反证
前三季营收277.69亿元、归母净利润85.87亿元，同比增173.74%；10月29日收582.05元、跌8.53%，财报收盘后披露，尚无公告后确认。来源：巨潮资讯。
业绩
新易盛增长仍强，但环比与现金流需消化
前三季营收109.40亿元、归母净利润38.43亿元；第三季利润环比约降19%，经营现金流同比下降。10月29日收228.40元、跌11.06%。来源：巨潮资讯。
业绩
生益科技盈利与现金流同步改善
第三季营收同比增78.76%、归母净利润34.40亿元并增238.40%；前三季经营现金流60.66亿元、增90.99%。10月29日收94.12元、跌8.17%。来源：公司三季报。
并购
东方证券合并上海证券获上交所审核通过
发行A股及现金购买上海证券100%股权仍需证监会及其他主管部门注册或批准；10月29日收8.25元、跌1.43%，协同需对照摊薄和整合成本。来源：巨潮资讯。
港股
吉利销量与利润增长，股价反馈仍偏弱
九个月收入2725.64亿元、归母净利润139.28亿元，核心利润增41%，但10月29日盘中约13.67港元、跌约4%，不能只凭增长包装为多头。来源：HKEX。
港股
百威亚太量价承压，列为回避
九个月收入46.2亿美元、降3.7%，销量降4.9%，正常化EBITDA降13.2%；第三季销量降10.1%，10月29日收5.66港元、跌2.58%。来源：HKEX。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数
本轮08:33 CST重新查询后，QQQ、SPY、DIA延迟代理分别报-1.41%、-0.35%、-0.36%，行情时间07:59 CST；来源未标识有效盘后成交，因此只作延迟代理，不冒充指数期货。
板块对照
板块对照
互联网内容与信息隔夜-9.77%，Amazon盘后最多跌7%、Intel盘后显著下跌，对港股互联网和高估值科技构成确认。CRMT、ADT、LUXE、GTN.A、CROX、MINE、DASH、EXK、TEX、MAX、LLY、NCLH、ESCA、HII、ARAY均未取得可核验盘后成交，不能默认延续；指数代理偏弱使正向榜单总体背离，尚不能判为反转。
A/H 映射
A/H 映射
开盘验证恒生科技、港股互联网及A股光模块/PCB相对强度；若中际旭创、生益科技守住前收附近且板块跌幅收敛，条件关注才有效。若HSTECH继续弱于恒指、科技龙头低开后30分钟无承接，则降权。

盘前结论

事实：截至10:18，上证跌0.63%、创业板跌1.33%，较09:45收窄；恒指涨1.17%、恒科涨1.22%，港股相对优势扩大。

判断：大盘仍是A弱H强，但A股AI算力不再是普遍走弱。工业富联强业绩叠加逆势上涨，提供有本地利润和价格反馈的正向分支。

工业富联升级为确认关注；中际旭创虽反弹至581.05元仍未重回582.05元闸门，生益科技与东方证券也未重回阈值，三者继续回避。百威亚太反弹不改变负面基本面。

重点个股关注

工业富联
SH.601138
确认关注

事实与状态：第三季营收3835.54亿元、增57.73%，归母净利润166.34亿元、增60.35%；截至10:18报45.75元、涨1.17%，在上证下跌时形成相对强势。

确认条件：维持45.22元前收上方，并继续强于上证及AI服务器链；价格回落至前收下方则降级。

风险与失效条件：前三季度经营现金流32.16亿元，明显低于403.75亿元归母净利润，应收账款和存货上升；高资本占用与AI订单兑现需持续跟踪。

中际旭创
SZ.300308
回避

事实与状态：截至10:18报581.05元、跌0.17%，已从早盘低位反弹，但仍低于582.05元再评估线。

再评估条件：重新站稳582.05元，并相对创业板和通信设备形成持续量价强势。

风险与失效条件：Amazon/Intel负反馈仍压制AI资本开支交易；未越过闸门前不恢复多头状态。

生益科技
SH.600183
回避

事实与状态：截至10:18报91.08元、跌3.23%，虽较早盘回升，仍低于94元再评估线。

再评估条件：重新站稳94元附近，并相对电子、PCB同业连续转强。

风险与失效条件：原材料、扩产消化与高预期兑现；当前价格仍未确认业绩利好。

东方证券
SH.600958
回避

事实与状态：截至10:18报8.19元、跌0.73%，仍低于8.25元再评估线，并购公告未获价格确认。

再评估条件：重新站稳8.25元并与券商板块同步转强，且后续注册审批推进。

风险与失效条件：注册、发行摊薄与整合成本；单一公告不能替代价格验证。

百威亚太
HK.01876
回避

事实与状态：截至10:18报5.92港元、涨4.59%，但销量与正常化EBITDA分别下降4.9%和13.2%，基本面未反转。

再评估条件：等待中国区销量、利润率改善，并持续强于恒指消费板块；单日反弹不足以确认。

风险与失效条件：需求、销量和利润率仍弱；不得把反弹包装成多头推荐。

板块轮动看板

确认方向AI服务器、机柜与高速网络：工业富联业绩和盘中相对强势形成双重确认。
相对强势恒指与恒生科技继续跑赢A股；港股科技修复扩大，但仍需防日内回吐。
压力方向A股高估值成长、PCB与券商并购；生益科技和东方证券仍未重回价格闸门。
验证信号工业富联能否守住45.22元、中际能否站上582.05元，以及恒科能否维持红盘。

逻辑链

隔夜美股科技负反馈压低整体风险偏好，A股成长早盘先大幅下挫。
截至10:18，A股跌幅收窄、港股科技涨幅扩大，市场从普遍科技抛售转为内部显著分化。
工业富联AI服务器和网络业务高增，且股价逆势上涨，为A股AI算力提供本地利润与价格双确认。
因此新增工业富联确认关注，但不外推至仍未越过阈值的中际旭创、生益科技和东方证券。

风险雷达

创业板仍跌1.33%，A股成长修复尚未转为指数级确认。
工业富联现金转换偏弱、应收账款与存货上升，强利润增长伴随营运资金占用。
Amazon与Intel负反馈仍可能令AI资本开支链继续去估值。
中际旭创仅接近而未越过582.05元闸门，不能提前恢复多头状态。
百威亚太反弹不改变销量与EBITDA下滑，不能据此转为多头。

数据来源与时间点

规则：最新 main 的 brief_rules.md（SHA 136f8358）。本轮复核截止：2026-10-30 10:18 CST。行情：东方财富云端行情，指数与个股同批次延迟快照。新增遗漏条目1项、进入正文1项：工业富联三季报，首次可得于10月29日20:01 CST，来源为法定披露全文。首轮AKShare及美股排行快照未变化；复核生成：2026-10-30 10:28 CST。

US communication servicesAI capexNarrower A-share lossesHong Kong tech strengthNetwork policyOptics near the gateCCL price invalidationBroker deal unconfirmedBeer demandHainan FTPHigh oil pricesFII confirmation
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News Summary
Global
Diplomacy hopes lowered oil, but supply risks remain
Brent settled at $114.88, down 0.38%, and WTI at $102, down 0.76%. Diplomacy hopes coexist with Houthi attacks and Hormuz risks. Source: Reuters.
Policy
Four agencies issued Hainan FTP trade-facilitation measures
The Oct 29 notice covers 16 measures including auto testing imports, LNG delivery, insurance, offshore trade and remanufacturing; benefits still need implementation and orders. Source: MOFCOM.
Industry
MIIT called for coordinated next-generation network buildout
The meeting covered terrestrial, space, international and integrated networks plus land, power, spectrum and financing support. This is a medium-term signal, not an immediate order. Source: MIIT.
Market
A-share growth extended losses while Hong Kong tech stabilised
At 09:45 CST on Oct 30, SSE was down 1.21% and ChiNext 3.16%, while HSI rose 0.62% and HSTECH 0.30%, shifting the A/H picture from shared tech pressure to A-share weakness and Hong Kong resilience. Source: Eastmoney cloud quotes.
US
Communication services and software sank; internet content ranked last
Nasdaq fell 1.37% and SOX 1.4%; Alphabet lost 12.6%, FTNT and NOW more than 20%, and MRVL 13.2%. Internet Content ranked -9.77%, versus Auto Dealerships +7.57% and Security +5.95%. Sources: Reuters, ranking snapshot.
After hours
Amazon and Intel reinforced concern over AI returns
AWS revenue rose 39% to $46 billion, but Amazon's trailing cash flow was negative $42.4 billion and capex topped estimates, sending shares down as much as 7%; Intel drew a sharper reaction. Source: Reuters.
Earnings
FII earnings and price action jointly confirmed an AI-infrastructure branch
Q3 revenue was RMB383.554bn, up 57.73%, and net profit RMB16.634bn, up 60.35%. Cloud revenue rose 75% year on year and 25% sequentially, while AI-GPU rack shipments rose 70%. At 10:18 the stock was CNY45.75, up 1.17% and outperforming SSE. Sources: statutory disclosure, Eastmoney cloud quotes.
Results
Zhongji Innolight grew sharply, but pre-report weakness is counterevidence
Nine-month revenue was RMB27.769bn and attributable profit RMB8.587bn, up 173.74%. The stock closed at RMB582.05, down 8.53%; the after-close report lacks post-report confirmation. Source: CNINFO.
Results
Eoptolink growth remained strong, but sequential and cash-flow pressure matter
Nine-month revenue was RMB10.940bn and profit RMB3.843bn. Q3 profit fell about 19% sequentially and operating cash flow declined year over year; the stock closed at RMB228.40, down 11.06%. Source: CNINFO.
Results
Shengyi Technology improved both earnings and cash flow
Q3 revenue rose 78.76% and profit reached RMB3.440bn, up 238.40%; nine-month operating cash flow was RMB6.066bn, up 90.99%. The stock closed at RMB94.12, down 8.17%. Source: filing.
M&A
Orient Securities' acquisition passed exchange review
The share-and-cash purchase of 100% of Shanghai Securities still needs CSRC and other approvals or registration. The stock closed at RMB8.25, down 1.43%; synergies must be weighed against dilution and integration. Source: CNINFO.
Hong Kong
Geely grew volume and profit, but price feedback stayed weak
Nine-month revenue was RMB272.564bn and profit RMB13.928bn, with core profit up 41%; the stock was around HKD13.67, down about 4% intraday, so growth alone is not bullish confirmation. Source: HKEX.
Hong Kong
BUD APAC's volume and margins weakened; status is Avoid
Nine-month revenue fell 3.7% to $4.62bn, volume fell 4.9% and normalized EBITDA fell 13.2%; Q3 volume fell 10.1%. The stock closed at HKD5.66, down 2.58%. Source: HKEX.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight indices
Overnight indices
A fresh 08:33 CST check returned delayed proxies of -1.41% for QQQ, -0.35% for SPY and -0.36% for DIA, with a 07:59 CST quote time. The source did not identify valid after-hours trades, so these are proxies, not index futures.
Sector comparison
Sector comparison
Internet Content & Information was -9.77%; Amazon fell as much as 7% after hours and Intel fell sharply, a confirmation of pressure on Hong Kong internet and high-valuation technology. Verifiable after-hours trades were unavailable for CRMT, ADT, LUXE, GTN.A, CROX, MINE, DASH, EXK, TEX, MAX, LLY, NCLH, ESCA, HII and ARAY. Weak proxies create a divergence from positive rankings, but do not yet confirm a reversal.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
Test relative strength in HSTECH, Hong Kong internet and A-share optics/PCB. Conditional Watch requires Zhongji and Shengyi to hold near prior closes while sector losses narrow; continued HSTECH underperformance or no first-30-minute support invalidates.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: at 10:18, SSE was down 0.63% and ChiNext 1.33%, narrower than at 09:45; HSI rose 1.17% and HSTECH 1.22%, extending Hong Kong's relative lead.

View: the market remains A-share weak and Hong Kong strong, but A-share AI infrastructure is no longer uniformly weak. FII's strong results and positive price response create a locally verified branch.

FII moves to Confirmed Watch. Zhongji rebounded to CNY581.05 but stayed below its CNY582.05 gate; Shengyi and Orient Securities also remained below thresholds, so all three stay Avoid. BUD APAC's bounce does not reverse weak fundamentals.

Stocks to Watch

FII
SH.601138
Confirmed Watch

Facts and status: Q3 revenue was RMB383.554bn, up 57.73%, and net profit RMB16.634bn, up 60.35%. At 10:18 the stock was CNY45.75, up 1.17% while SSE fell.

Confirmation: Hold above the CNY45.22 prior close and continue to outperform SSE and AI-server peers; a break below prior close downgrades the call.

Risk and invalidation: Nine-month operating cash flow was RMB3.216bn versus RMB40.375bn net profit, while receivables and inventory rose. Working-capital intensity and AI order conversion need monitoring.

Zhongji Innolight
SZ.300308
Avoid

Facts and status: At 10:18 it was CNY581.05, down 0.17% after rebounding from the morning low, but still below the CNY582.05 reassessment gate.

Reassessment: Retake CNY582.05 and sustain volume-backed strength versus ChiNext and communications equipment.

Risk and invalidation: Amazon/Intel weakness still pressures the AI capex trade; no bullish restoration before the gate is cleared.

Shengyi Technology
SH.600183
Avoid

Facts and status: At 10:18 it was CNY91.08, down 3.23%; it recovered from the low but remained below the CNY94 reassessment gate.

Reassessment: Retake roughly CNY94 and sustain relative strength versus electronics and PCB peers.

Risk and invalidation: Raw materials, capacity absorption and high expectations remain risks; price has not confirmed the earnings catalyst.

Orient Securities
SH.600958
Avoid

Facts and status: At 10:18 it was CNY8.19, down 0.73% and below the CNY8.25 reassessment gate; the merger filing still lacks price confirmation.

Reassessment: Retake CNY8.25 with broker-sector strength and further registration progress.

Risk and invalidation: Registration, dilution and integration costs; one filing cannot replace price validation.

BUD APAC
HK.01876
Avoid

Facts and status: At 10:18 it was HKD5.92, up 4.59%, but volume and normalized EBITDA fell 4.9% and 13.2%; fundamentals have not reversed.

Reassessment: Wait for improving China volume and margins plus sustained strength versus Hang Seng consumer peers; one rebound is insufficient.

Risk and invalidation: Demand, volume and margins remain weak; the rebound must not be packaged as bullish.

Sector Rotation Board

ConfirmedAI servers, racks and high-speed networking: FII combines strong earnings with intraday relative strength.
Relative strengthHSI and HSTECH continue to outperform A shares; Hong Kong technology recovery is broader but still vulnerable to intraday reversal.
PressureHigh-valuation A-share growth, PCB and broker consolidation; Shengyi and Orient Securities remain below price gates.
ValidationWhether FII holds CNY45.22, Zhongji clears CNY582.05, and HSTECH stays positive.

Logic Chain

Overnight US technology weakness reduced broad risk appetite, and A-share growth sold off sharply at the open.
By 10:18, A-share losses narrowed while Hong Kong technology gains widened, shifting the market from uniform selling to sharp internal divergence.
FII's AI-server and networking growth plus a positive stock move provide both local profit and price confirmation for A-share AI infrastructure.
FII therefore enters Confirmed Watch, without extrapolating the call to Zhongji, Shengyi or Orient Securities while they remain below gates.

Risk Radar

ChiNext remained down 1.33%, so A-share growth recovery is not yet index-level confirmation.
FII's cash conversion was weak while receivables and inventory rose, making working-capital intensity a key risk.
Amazon and Intel weakness may continue to compress AI capex valuations.
Zhongji approached but did not clear CNY582.05, so bullish status cannot be restored early.
BUD APAC's rebound does not reverse falling volume and EBITDA and is not a bullish signal.
